description: This PHP source file defines a controller class 'SaveSystemUserController' within the OrangeHRM framework. The class manages the rendering of a view component for saving or editing system users, configuring component properties based on request attributes and social media authentication state.

classes.name: SaveSystemUserController
classes.description: A controller responsible for managing the save/edit system user view in the OrangeHRM framework. It initializes the appropriate Vue component with properties indicating whether a password is required and the user ID if editing an existing user.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the Vue component for rendering by determining the context (edit or create user) and password requirement, then configuring component properties accordingly.
